research_summary: Current official Gigaclear material centres on three symmetrical FTTP tiers, rural availability, WiFi 7 eero hardware and switching incentives. The page adopts the decision-friendly SERP structure while adding total-cost maths, list-price renewal risk, installation permissions, Smart WiFi exclusions, source transparency and honest Awin readiness.
depth_rationale: The commercial query needs more than a deal card because Gigaclear has a narrow address-level footprint, its own physical network, unusual symmetrical uploads, mesh terms and a large gap between promotion and list price. At least 2,200 words provides a complete purchase decision without repeating generic fibre explanations.
